The '''LEC 2020 Summer Split''' was the second split of the 2020 [[League of Legends European Championship]] season, organized by Riot Games and held from June 12 to September 6, 2020. The season featured ten permanent partner teams competing in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs to determine the European champion.

The top four teams from the Playoffs qualified for the [[World Championship/2020|2020 World Championship]], with the split winner claiming the first European seed. Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, the entire season, including the Playoffs, was played online for the first time in league history.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''June 12th - August 9th, 2020''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}

* '''[[LEC/2020/Championship_Points|Championship Points]]'''
**Teams are awarded points based on their performances in their respective Spring Playoffs and Summer Regular Season.
**Points determine playoff seeding after participants are determined by summer placement.
**If a team finishes in 7th-10th in summer they lose all of their points.
**1st to 6th place will play the Playoffs

* '''Playoffs''' - ''August 22nd - September 6th, 2020''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Top 4 teams qualify for [[World Championship/2020|World Championship 2020]]
